meta.title: Read Room
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/styles/*.css in the app repository) and its captured screens. A quiet grey desk with one sheet of paper, ink type (Pretendard, as the app sets it), and the readers' highlighter colours; the reel moves like reading: slow camera, pen-speed sweeps.

source.notes: a small online reading room: one text, everyone's highlights and margin notes, discussion questions, shared by link or file without a server

the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json, the essay with and without its highlights; the essay, its author and the readers are the app's own fictional sample data
Pretendard Variable (the app's interface and default reading face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's desk and paper: desk #E3E4E7 / #D6D8DC, paper #FBFBFA, ink #17191D / #4B4F57, and the readers' highlighter colours (orange #FF9A3D, yellow #FFD23F, green #45D08B, blue #6FB2FF). The orange highlighter is the accent, swept behind a line as the app's own hero does; text never sits in a light colour.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 900 for headlines, ink on the desk, the key line marked with an orange highlighter sweep like the app's '함께 읽을 사람과.'; the essay itself is the captured page in the app's own reading type; JetBrains Mono capitals for labels ('A QUIET READING ROOM').
rationale.motion: The pace of reading: the camera moves down the page slowly, highlights draw on at pen speed along the real line boxes, margin notes slide in from the right and settle. Nothing jumps.
rationale.sound: Ambient in E major at 96 BPM (6 bars in 15 s, 12 in 30 s): a quiet room with soft pads and sparse bells, light drums, minimal SFX (a soft pen stroke for each highlight, a page swish).
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the name and the room's one-liner over the desk; real highlights drawn on in the real essay by two readers and their margin notes; the whole page with every reader's highlights beside the app's read-together panel (link, file, participants); the end card with the app's own line. The 30 s cut adds the discussion questions.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel; the reading happens on screen.
